title: finding: `moduleSpecifiers()` passes `setParentNodes: true` and nothing reads a parent — ~25% of two gates' dominant cost, byte-identical output without it
body:
Found while fixing #5402 (the `Test (coverage)` timeout). Recording it rather than riding it
along on that PR: it changes a parser **shared** by two gates, so it widens the verification
surface beyond that card. #5402 is closed without this — the measurement below is a separate,
optional saving. **Not assigned to anyone and nothing has been changed.**

## The observation

`scripts/check-phantom-dependencies.mjs` exports `moduleSpecifiers()`, the single
TypeScript-backed parser that both `check:phantom-deps` and `check:self-import` share:

```js
const source = ts.createSourceFile(fileName, text, ts.ScriptTarget.Latest, true, ts.ScriptKind.TSX);
```

That fourth argument is `setParentNodes`. Setting it makes TypeScript walk the finished tree
and assign `.parent` on every node — and nothing in `moduleSpecifiers()` reads a parent:

- the walk is `ts.forEachChild(node, visit)`, which descends and never ascends;
- positions come from `source.getLineAndCharacterOfPosition(node.getStart(source))`, and
  `getStart` is given the source file **explicitly**, which is exactly the argument that
  exists so it does not have to find it through `.parent`;
- the `source` object is local to the function and never escapes, so no caller can read a
  parent either.

## Measurement

Over this repository's real corpus — 44 packages, 3,094 source files, 30.3 MB, 15,550
module specifiers — same process, alternating legs to control for JIT warmup:

```
files 3094
setParentNodes=true   5174ms  specifiers=15550
setParentNodes=false  3600ms  specifiers=15550
setParentNodes=true   4496ms  specifiers=15550
setParentNodes=false  3620ms  specifiers=15550
identical output across all files: true  diffs: 0
```

The equality leg is the load-bearing one: `moduleSpecifiers()` was run **both ways over every
one of the 3,094 files** and the results compared as JSON — specifier, kind, `typeOnly`, line
and column. Zero differences. So this is not a trade; it is ~25% of the dominant cost of both
gates for no behavioural change.

It compounds under coverage. #5402 measured this same parse at a ~7x constant factor when v8
coverage is armed before `typescript` compiles, so a second saved on the uninstrumented parse
is worth roughly seven in the `Test (coverage)` lane.

## What would need checking before acting

- `check:phantom-deps` is the other consumer and has its own fixtures; its full suite would
  need to stay green, not just `check:self-import`'s.
- Whether any *future* caller wants parents is the real question the flag is answering today —
  if the answer is "no by design", the flag is better removed with a comment saying why than
  left as a silent cost.
- Worth confirming against the TypeScript version in use (`typescript@6.0.3` here), since
  `getStart(sourceFile)` semantics are what make the removal safe.

## Not a defect

Both gates are correct today and their verdicts do not change. This is a cost observation
only, which is why it is filed as a `finding` rather than a bug.
